case_study_packaging.readiness_notes: Client identity, objectives, quantified $1.96M savings, category-level proof points and detailed approach are all available.
case_study_packaging.headline: Nationwide fleet-service network unlocks $1.96M in annual savings in just six months, delivering 6x ROI through Treya’s sourcing program
case_study_packaging.client_problem_statement: Epika Fleet Services had grown through more than ten acquisitions, leaving eight business units buying parts, fuel and supplies independently with little spend visibility or purchasing leverage. Facing private-equity value-creation targets and an aggressive timeline, the company needed to unify its spend, negotiate national pricing and squeeze $0.7–1.6 million from costs without disrupting mission-critical maintenance operations.
case_study_packaging.client_problem_anonymized: A fast-growing fleet maintenance provider had expanded through more than ten acquisitions, leaving eight business units buying parts, fuel and supplies independently with little spend visibility or purchasing leverage. With the private equity ownership group prioritizing operational efficiency and margin improvement on a tight timeline, the company needed to unify its spend, negotiate national pricing and capture more than $0.7 million in cost savings without disrupting mission-critical maintenance operations.
approach_summary: Mapped $51.9 million in spend across 13 direct and indirect categories by stitching together AP/PO data from eight autonomous business units and collecting missing SKU-level detail directly from suppliers.
Prioritized high-impact categories representing 82% of addressable COGS spend and built competitive benchmarks to expose over-market pricing in oils, lubricants, filters and OEM parts.
Renegotiated incumbent contracts with Shell, Chevron, ExxonMobil and Fleetguard, securing national account pricing and enhanced rebates that cut lubricant and filter costs 10–15%.
Ran targeted RFQs and leveraged OMNIA cooperative contracts to consolidate fuel, office supplies, MRO and telematics, lowering vendor count while unlocking Tier-1 pricing and guaranteed rebates.

Partnered with operations leaders at all eleven business units to phase in new programs, enabling the first savings to hit the P&L within 90 days and ensuring smooth change management with strategic suppliers.
case_study_packaging.value_delivered_blurb: Treya delivered $1.96 million in verified annual run-rate savings—exceeding the high end of the original estimate by 19% and already locking in $1.47 million across nine categories. The savings translate to roughly a 6x return on Treya’s fixed fees while laying the groundwork for a centralized, data-driven procurement function that will continue to drive value post-engagement.
where_we_were_unique: Captured the first contract-backed savings within 90 days by attacking quick-win lubricant and filter opportunities in parallel with broader sourcing waves.
Leveraged deep aftermarket parts and fleet-services expertise to negotiate Level-3 OEM pricing many mid-market operators cannot access independently.
Executed hands-on data gathering directly from strategic suppliers to overcome the client’s fragmented spend systems and incomplete usage history.
Balanced aggressive cost reduction with sensitive supplier relationships, maintaining service continuity while still exceeding the high-end savings target.
